example.title: Dana Point Harbor West Basin main walkway and gangway dock
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: The main walk of the West Basin marina (1971): a railed concrete promenade along the bulkhead with white pipe rails and gates down to a long floating main dock of concrete pontoons, sailboats and motor yachts in slips on both sides. Two photos (at dusk). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
